WATCH: Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon says at least three out of the four pumps at the controversial Sunog Apog pumping station in Manila should be operational before the rainy season in 2026. 

The P774-million flood control facility was completed in 2020 during the Duterte administration, but was found dysfunctional and said to have worsened flooding.

The project was supposed to address flooding in Manila such as España, Sampaloc, Rizal Ave., and Maria Clara. | @bylancemejico
